scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a beige building with a parking sign and a scooter parked in front of it. The building has a black door and windows with bars on them. There is a small balcony on the second floor. A brown sign with white lettering reading 'Mama Cheva' is on the right side of the building. The ground is paved with gray concrete and there are yellow lines painted on it. The sidewalk is made of bricks and is next to the building. The sky is not visible.
